enh.t002: The list uses a few shorthands throughout. They are the developer's own wording.
enh.t005: Hits per attack in a combo. 5-2-4 means the 1st attack hits 5 times, the 2nd 2 times, the 3rd 4 times.
enh.t006: Normal attack / Heavy attack / Special attack.
enh.t007: What you must have for the buff to apply. It can be equipment, low HP, a character or a class.
enh.t008: A motion reworked for this server that does not exist in the original game.
enh.t009: A weapon that could not combo in the original game can now chain attacks.
enh.t010: Attack speed. This stacks with Battle units.
enh.t011: Everything here started with the Ver.0.7.8 major update, which introduced the framework for modifying items in ways that were not possible before.
enh.t013: Equip the item on the left and every weapon listed under it changes. One item usually covers several weapons, so it is worth checking what else you already own.

enh.t046: Which weapons deserve high Hit% and attribute%
enh.t047: Chasing a high percentage takes a long time, so it helps to know which weapons actually reward it. The lists below are the development team's own priority ranking.
enh.t048: The developer's note: the tier moves up or down depending on your priorities and playstyle (character, class, personal preference). Treat it as a starting point, not a rule.
enh.t052: YASMINKOV 9000M sits higher than tier A if you play RAmar or RAmarl.
enh.t054: Where to farm a given percentage is decided by the area, not the monster. The area table is on the Server Systems page.
enh.t055: Source: Discord #list-of-combo-bonus-buffed-items and #weapons-priority-list, both written by the development team. Values follow the original English notation and are not translated.
enh.t056: The developer marks the original list as still in progress, so entries may be added or adjusted later.
enh.t059: On this server a weapon can change completely once you equip the right unit, armor, mag or character. This page lists every enhancement condition and what it does, so you can tell at a glance what a weapon still needs.
